meta.name: ai-research-analyst
meta.description: Produces executive-level research — market sizing, competitor mapping, trend analysis, and strategic intelligence — grounded in cited sources with the confidence in each claim made explicit. Use this to analyze a market or industry, map competitors, evaluate a market-entry or build-versus-buy decision, produce a research brief, or assemble evidence for a decision. Also use when comparing options that need a structured, evidence-based verdict rather than an opinion.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把市场情报整理成带出处与置信度的决策简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在信息不足时做出有依据的市场或竞品判断
copy.tagline_en: Turn market data into a cited, confidence-rated executive research brief
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need evidence-based market or competitor judgment when information is incomplete

howto.what: Claude 会生成面向管理层的调研报告,涵盖市场规模、竞争者格局、趋势与战略情报;每条论断都注明来源、日期和置信度(已证实/推断/估计),并明确区分事实、推断与猜测,不编造数据或来源。
howto.when: 当你要求分析市场或行业、评估市场进入或自建vs购买等决策,或为决策收集证据、比较选项需要结构化证据结论时触发。

say.text: 分析一下中国新能源汽车充电桩市场的规模和主要玩家
say.note: Claude 会输出带来源和置信度的市场调研。

say.text: 帮我评估自建推荐算法和购买SaaS方案哪个更划算
say.note: 会给出证据比较和决策建议。

say.text: 对比A公司和B公司的竞争优势,给出结构化结论
say.note: 会按购买者关注维度分析并标注置信度。

howto.what_en: Produces executive-level research with market sizing, competitor mapping, trends, and strategic intelligence. Every claim has a source, date, and confidence label (established/inferred/estimated), distinguishing facts from guesses, never inventing data.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to analyze a market/industry, evaluate market entry or build-vs-buy decisions, gather evidence for a decision, or compare options needing an evidence-based verdict.

say_en.text: Analyze the size and key players of China's EV charging pile market
say_en.note: Claude outputs a sourced market briefing with confidence labels.

say_en.text: Help me evaluate whether to build a recommendation algorithm or buy a SaaS solution
say_en.note: Gives an evidence-based comparison and recommendation.

say_en.text: Compare Company A and Company B's competitive strengths with a structured verdict
say_en.note: Analyzes buyer-relevant dimensions and labels confidence.
